divergences.upstreamResult: React route factories run through React server and client APIs.
divergences.octaneResult: The same route factories run through separate Octane server/client compiler graphs and native readable streams.
divergences.rationale: Octane compilation selects server and client runtime ownership.
divergences.consumerImpact: SSR fixtures must be compiled for their execution environment.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Use octane/server and native readable streams.
divergences.reviewCondition: Recheck when the pinned upstream case or Octane renderer contract changes.

divergences.upstreamResult: React forwardRef and legacy ref injection type the wrapped component.
divergences.octaneResult: A component declares its native ref prop; arbitrary custom components receive ref/key only when their public props declare them.
divergences.rationale: Octane refs are ordinary typed props.
divergences.consumerImpact: Declare the ref accepted by a custom Link component.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Replace forwardRef wrappers with a typed ref prop.
divergences.reviewCondition: Recheck when the pinned upstream case or Octane renderer contract changes.

divergences.upstreamResult: The React test mocks useSyncExternalStore for its server snapshot.
divergences.octaneResult: The native hydration snapshot runs through the actual Octane hook.
divergences.rationale: Mocks of React hooks cannot observe the Octane runtime.
divergences.consumerImpact: Hydration uses the native server snapshot and follows the live client value.
divergences.reviewCondition: Recheck when the pinned upstream case or Octane renderer contract changes.

divergences.upstreamResult: A React class boundary catches the rendered failure.
divergences.octaneResult: The native function ErrorBoundary catches that same failure.
divergences.rationale: Octane supports function boundaries without class components.
divergences.consumerImpact: The fallback and cleanup remain observable.
divergences.reviewCondition: Recheck when the pinned upstream case or Octane renderer contract changes.

divergences.upstreamResult: The React observer may be initialized again by development StrictMode.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane mounts once and the same observer remains live.
divergences.rationale: Octane does not replay mounts under StrictMode.
divergences.consumerImpact: The retained observer must continue receiving intersection events.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Retain native observer identity and release it on teardown.
divergences.reviewCondition: Recheck when the pinned upstream case or Octane renderer contract changes.

divergences.upstreamResult: The React navigation helper finishes before the test retains a fallback node.
divergences.octaneResult: Native act settles the pending-to-idle boundary reset before the test retains that node.
divergences.rationale: Native commits preserve the same final fallback while resetting ownership during navigation.
divergences.consumerImpact: DOM assertions must inspect the committed live node.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Wrap asynchronous navigation interactions in the native act helper.
divergences.reviewCondition: Recheck when the pinned upstream case or Octane renderer contract changes.
